name: @salon/dashboard
description: Owner dashboard (D1-D20) — appointments, leads, the handoff queue and system health. Deploys to OUR OWN SERVER behind Cloudflare Access, never to Vercel: that separation is the proof that the database credential and the PII read path do not reach a third party, because the code is not there (Phase 6 decision D-1). READ-ONLY: it reads Postgres as salon_ro (D5, MIGRATION-PLAN §3t); the one write action (D11, release the handoff lock) goes through a protected n8n path, never straight to the store.
